# BATI VERT Construction

BATI VERT is a premier general contractor and construction company based in Montreal, Quebec. We specialize in turnkey services, sustainable construction, bespoke design, and master renovations. 

## Services
- General Contracting
- Sustainable Construction
- Turnkey Delivery
- Bespoke Design & Architecture
- Master Renovations & Expansions
- Window Installation & Replacement (Energy Star® Certified)

## Service Area
We proudly serve Montreal and surrounding regions.
